definitions.explanation: The sudden cessation of heart function, in which the heart stops pumping blood effectively. A life-threatening medical emergency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{試合中|しあいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{心停止|しんていし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: The athlete went into cardiac arrest during the game.

examples.japanese: {心停止|しんていし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧AED⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: In case of cardiac arrest, please use an AED immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}→救急隊：26173_kyuukyuutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すでに{心停止|しんていし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{心肺蘇生|しんぱいそせい}→心肺蘇生：29912_shinpaisosei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{一命|いちめい}→一命：11239_ichimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{留|と}めた→取り留める：15466_toritomeru⟧。
examples.english: The patient was already in cardiac arrest when paramedics arrived, but their life was saved through CPR.

notes:
A compound of {心|しん} (heart) and ⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧ (stoppage, cessation). A critical medical term that appears frequently in news reports and emergency medical contexts.

In Japan, AEDs ({自動体外式除細動器|じどうたいがいしきじょさいどうき}) are widely installed in public places — train stations, schools, shopping centers, and offices. Public awareness campaigns have made {心停止|しんていし} and basic life-saving procedures well known to the general public.

Note: In Japanese medical and legal contexts, {心停止|しんていし} (cardiac arrest) is distinct from {心臓死|しんぞうし} (cardiac death). A person in cardiac arrest may still be resuscitated.
